title: Financial-education relay on promotional credit-card financing and disclosure
published_window: 2025-11; retrieved within the current search window
discussion_signal: The post relays CFPB guidance distinguishing 0% introductory APR from deferred-interest 'no interest if paid in full' offers and highlights the consumer need to understand when interest is calculated or added. It is a financial-education and policy relay, not evidence of consumer comprehension, realized fee avoidance, or repayment success.
linked_research_question: Which parts of a product's promotional and fee structure become practically legible to consumers, and when does disclosure convert into lower cost or usable choice?
limits: The post summarizes guidance rather than reporting a measured outcome
It does not identify a representative audience or account-level behavior
